parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Eta point W = 1.7, Q2 = 1.0, cos = 0, phi = 90, but set vcut to -0.1.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
I’ll preflight the requested eta kinematics with `vcut = -0.1`; the result will determine whether to refuse, correct, or generate with an explicit warning.

The kinematics pass all physical and table-coverage checks. `vcut = -0.1` is accepted but triggers EXCLURAD’s documented alternate “v” interpretation, so I’m preserving it and generating the input with a warning flag.
The kinematics pass. `vcut = -0.1` is accepted but triggers EXCLURAD’s negative-`v` interpretation, so I’m preserving the requested value and recording the warning alongside the generated input.
